name: Gisela, Blade of Goldnight
oracle_text:
Flying, first strike
If a source would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, that source deals double that damage to that player or permanent instead.
If a source would deal damage to you or a permanent you control, prevent half that damage, rounded up.
blocked_sentences: If a source would deal damage to you or a permanent you control, prevent half that damage, rounded up.

needs.what: a static damage-prevention shield whose prevented amount is a fraction of each damage event (half, rounded up) rather than a fixed number, applying to damage dealt to you (affects_player: you) or a permanent you control (affects: controller you)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The prevent_damage static subtracts a fixed static_value 'amount' from each event (prevented_player_damage / prevented_damage sum constants) and static_value_keys has no reference to the incoming event's damage nor a 'half' leaf; prevent_all_but caps at a fixed amount; replace_damage's damage_multiplier is an integer >= 2 and the loader refuses anything lower, so it cannot halve
